body.subject: Reminder: Q1 Planning Meeting Tomorrow
body.body:
Hi all,

Just a reminder that we have the quarterly planning meeting tomorrow at 2pm.

Please review the attached agenda and come prepared with your team's updates.
Key discussion points:
- Q4 retrospective
- Q1 roadmap priorities
- Resource allocation for new initiatives

Looking forward to seeing everyone there.

Best,
David
